keyword: did brock lesnar win at wrestlemania 42
claims: Brock Lesnar lost to Oba Femi in the opening match of Night 2 of WrestleMania 42 on April 19, 2026.
Oba Femi pinned Brock Lesnar following a chokeslam and a powerbomb.
Brock Lesnar left his gloves and boots in the ring following the loss.
Brock Lesnar saluted the crowd following the loss.
Brock Lesnar shared an emotional moment with Paul Heyman after the match.
Brock Lesnar hit his signature F5 during the match.
The match took place at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas, Nevada.
